channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Argentino das urnas é denunciado por tentativa de feminicídio
item.description: The Santa Cruz prosecutor's office (Argentina) filed a formal indictment against Fernando Cerimedo, known in Brazil for questioning the voting machines in 2022, for attempted femicide against his partner. Cerimedo serves as an advisor to President Rodrigo Paz and is part of the Argentine government's digital team.

item.title: Crusoé: Lulinha também processa Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Entrepreneur Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, sued Senator Flávio Bolsonaro over alleged links to the INSS pension fraud scandal. The case involves an AI-generated video, escalating legal clashes between factions tied to the Bolsonaro and Lula legacies.

item.title: O apresentador de TV que é esperança de puxador de votos em São Paulo
item.description: TV host Sikêra Jr., known for conservative and controversial speeches, was nominated for federal deputy in Sao Paulo by Republicanos with the support of Governor Tarcisio de Freitas and the party's president, Marcos Pereira. His candidacy aims to expand the party's caucus, leveraging his media profile and public security discourse. Despite his prominence, Sikêra faces convictions for transphobic and discriminatory speeches against the LGBTQIA+ community.

item.title: Caiado ironiza Flávio após ele dizer que Dark Horse é "página virada"
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado mocked Flávio Bolsonaro for not delivering accounts regarding the film 'Dark Horse', financed with R$61 million from jailed banker Daniel Vorcaro. Flávio claimed the case is 'closed', but Caiado questions the delay and accuracy of the accounts.

item.title: Com Tarcísio, Flávio diz que quer entrar para a história mesmo que como ‘um presidente de transição’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated, during a campaign event with Tarcísio de Freitas in São Paulo, that he aims to be part of Brazilian history, even as a 'transition president,' praising the governor and reinforcing strategic alliances. Support from mayor Ricardo Nunes seeks to expand influence in the metropolitan region.

item.title: “Você tem potencial de algum dia ser presidente”, diz Flávio a Nikolas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated in a YouTube video that federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) has potential to become president in the future. The comment was made during a political discussion about Nikolas' trajectory; at 30 years old, he can only run for president in 2034 under current rules. Flávio also expressed uncertainty about the length of the presidential term after his potential mandate.

item.title: Vice de Flávio ironiza Motta após Câmara negar escolta na campanha
item.description: Alfredo Gaspar, Flávio Bolsonaro's running mate, mocked Hugo Motta after the Chamber denied legislative police protection during the campaign. Gaspar said he won't ask for favors, respecting the decision as an institutional matter.

item.title: A aposta de vice de Renan Santos para que candidato enfrente Lula no segundo turno
item.description: Aroldo Medina, running mate of Renan Santos (Missão), believes the presidential candidate could reach the runoff against Lula, emphasizing that 70% of voters are unaware of Renan and his growth potential. Recent polls show Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro leading, but Renan fluctuates between 4% and 7.8% in voting intentions.

item.title: Cappelli promete programa para valorizar professores na rede pública
item.description: Ricardo Cappelli (PSB), candidate for Federal District Governor, pledged to offer public school teachers the highest salary in Brazil and criticized the current administration's low IDEB scores. He also proposed integrated health systems, addressing root causes of homelessness, and a broader left-wing alliance, without progress on the vice-governor proposal with Leandro Grass (PT).

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro se defende sobre ‘Dark Horse’: “Página virada”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, presidential candidate from PL, stated he has already provided the necessary accounting and clarifications regarding expenses for the Dark Horse documentary, which covers Jair Bolsonaro's trajectory. He said 'page turned' when asked about charges from the PT.

item.title: Mendonça determina remoção de vídeo de IA que liga Flávio a Vorcaro
item.description: TSE Minister André Mendonça ordered the removal of an AI-generated video linking Senator Flávio Bolsonaro to the founder of Banco Master, Daniel Vorcaro, citing it as a misleading fabrication. The video, posted on August 14, incorporates visual elements from Flávio's campaign and was described as a musical satire. The decision responds to a request from Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign.

item.title: Lulinha vai à Justiça e pede indenização de Flávio por vídeo com IA
item.description: Fábio Luiz Lula da Silva, son of President Lula, filed a lawsuit against Flávio Bolsonaro over an AI-generated video accusing him of pension fraud. His defense team seeks the removal of the post, R$10,000 in moral damages, and a ban on repeating the false allegations. The lawsuit was filed in São Paulo state court after the video was posted on July 7th across social media platforms.

item.title: Haddad: ‘Tarcísio presta um desserviço a São Paulo ao apoiar Flávio Bolsonaro’
item.description: Haddad criticized Tarcísio for supporting Flávio Bolsonaro, calling him an institutional risk. He advocates federal cooperation against crime and highlights Finance Ministry investments.

item.title: STF arquiva queixa de Weverton Rocha contra Kim Kataguiri
item.description: The STF dismissed Senator Weverton Rocha's criminal complaint against Congressman Kim Kataguiri, ruling that the deputy was protected by parliamentary immunity when commenting on INSS investigations. The unanimous decision stated that the statements were part of legislative debate.

item.title: Casas Bahia, blusinhas e 6×1 levam campanha para a rotina do eleitor
item.description: The 2026 election campaign shifts focus to voters' daily lives, emphasizing supermarket prices and consumption. Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leverages high inflation and Lula's government setbacks, while Lula (PT) counters with favorable economic data. The race now unfolds in settings like stores and social media, with direct price comparisons.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula anuncia supercomputador de IA, em Macaíba
item.description: President Lula announced the deployment of an AI-dedicated supercomputer during a visit to the Augusto Severo Scientific and Technological Park in Macaíba (RN). The initiative aims to enhance Brazil's technological capabilities, support scientific research, and boost the national economy.

item.title: Caiado defende presença obrigatória em debates e diz que candidatos que não vão 'têm muito a esconder'
item.description: Caiado advocates for mandatory candidate participation in electoral debates, criticizing Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro for not attending the Band debate. He also proposes legislative reform to establish clear rules for debates and discusses the possibility of debates organized by press consortia.

item.title: Tarcísio e a caixa preta da bilhetagem
item.description: The São Paulo state government maintains, without public bidding, a metropolitan transportation ticketing system managed by Abasp, whose 2020 contract with Autopass has drawn scrutiny from the court of auditors and the public prosecutors. The state regulator Artesp recently ruled that passenger balances can no longer fund the operator's costs, yet Tarcísio de Freitas persists in defending the model as a deliberate, recorded decision.

item.title: TSE manda remover vídeo com IA que liga Flávio Bolsonaro a Vorcaro
item.description: TSE minister André Mendonça ordered the removal of an AI-generated video linking Flávio Bolsonaro to Daniel Vorcaro. The content must be taken down from platforms within 24 hours of notification.

item.title: Governo amplia a R$ 200 mil teto de financiamento para motoristas de apps de olho em eleição
item.description: The federal government raised the financing ceiling for app and taxi drivers' vehicles from R$150,000 to R$200,000, now including hybrid and electric cars. The measure aims to reduce costs and modernize the fleet, directly impacting the economy of workers in the sector.

item.title: O peso da nova indicação de Lula ao STF na sua viagem com Alcolumbre para o Amapá
item.description: Lula has been avoiding discussing with Davi Alcolumbre a new indication of Jorge Messias to the STF, while planning a trip to Amapá with the Senate President. The PT strategy takes into account the political calculation involving Alcolumbre in the definition of Supreme Court nominations.

item.title: "Impunidade gera mais crime", diz Haddad em sabatina
item.description: Haddad advocates for punishing more crimes to fight impunity, criticizing empty promises of harsher sentences. He proposes police investment, AI use, and body cameras, while criticizing Tarcísio's support for Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Sabatina GLOBO/CBN/Valor: Veja como foi a entrevista com Tarcísio em cinco pontos
item.description: Tarcísio advocated for ending reelection for executive positions, expressed full confidence in the security of electronic voting machines, and supported the impeachment of Supreme Court justices. On security, he emphasized measures against femicide and the maintenance of PM body cameras. In education, he promised a new teacher competition and reinforcement in mathematics.

item.title: Análise - Tarcísio assume persona de 'concurseiro', apresenta plataforma nacional e esquece Flávio
item.description: In a recent interview, Tarcísio de Freitas adopted the profile of a 'competitive exam candidate', presenting a detailed national platform focused on state data and programs, while largely ignoring Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign. Leading the state race by 15 points over Haddad, the governor emphasized technical management and defended electronic voting and STF impeachment as valid tools, distancing himself from the national convergence strategy of bolsonarism.

item.title: Deputado pede ao TSE verba e tempo de TV para pessoas com deficiência
item.description: Federal deputy Zacharias Calil (MDB-GO) requested clarification from the TSE on whether disability candidates should receive proportional funding from the Party Fund and Special Campaign Fund, plus radio and TV time in the 2026 elections. The consultation seeks to apply similar rules to those used for women, Black, and Indigenous candidates, aiming for greater political inclusion of people with disabilities.

item.title: Nikolas faz “ping-pong” com Flávio: “Lula em uma palavra? Passado”
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) conducted a question-and-answer session with presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), posted on YouTube on Thursday (20). When asked about Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), Flávio described him as 'past'. During the conversation, Flávio also reflected on personal regrets, mentioning times he missed being with his family and mistakes he made in life.

item.title: PL pede ao TSE fiscalização de propaganda em rádios após alegar fraude em 2022
item.description: The PL asked the TSE to create monitoring mechanisms for free electoral advertising, suggesting that broadcasters maintain electronic records of downloads and displays of campaign ads, after alleging irregularities in the 2022 elections. The proposal was presented by Maria Claudia Bucchianeri, legal coordinator of Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign, and rejected by representatives of Abert, who consider the measure unfeasible for thousands of broadcasters.

item.title: Kássio dará o voto de Minerva sobre candidatura de Crivella ao Senado
item.description: TSE president Kassio Nunes Marques will cast the deciding vote on whether Marcelo Crivella can run for the Senate in 2026, following investigations into the 'QG da Propina' scheme. The decision will be finalized by 11:59 PM Thursday, maintaining the injunction granted by Minister André Mendonça that suspends the ineligibility of the former Rio de Janeiro mayor.

item.title: Quando a tela passa do limite: o celular não quer apenas seu tempo, mas também sua atenção
item.description: A study by Instituto Alana shows that 50% of Brazilian teens spend more time online than they wish, affecting mental health and academic performance. The debate over excessive screen use intensifies with criticism of manipulative social media design, pushing for regulation and parental controls.

item.title: Tarcísio presta desserviço ao apoiar o bolsonarismo, diz Haddad
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT) criticized Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) for supporting bolsonarism, stating it does a disservice to São Paulo state. The candidate emphasized that Jair Bolsonaro did not contribute to the state's development and considers Flávio Bolsonaro an institutional risk to the country.

item.title: Lula foi avisado por advogado sobre pedido da PGR em caso de Lulinha
item.description: President Lula was informed that the PGR requested the Supreme Court to send an investigation involving his son Fábio Luís (Lulinha) to first-instance courts. The case probes alleged influence peddling within the government, linked to the INSS scandal. Lawyer Marco Aurélio de Carvalho discussed defense strategy with Lula, arguing the case might be dismissed if it didn't carry the Lula surname.

item.title: Investigação sobre grupo extremista que planejava agir nas eleições pode chegar ao TSE
item.description: The National Council of Human Rights (CNDH) requested the Secretariat of Public Security of the Federal District to share information about the 'Operação Rede Interrompida' and consider forwarding investigative elements related to the 2026 elections to the Superior Electoral Court (TSE). The operation investigates an extremist group planning actions during the electoral process.

item.title: Em SP, Flávio enfrenta 2º protesto ao chegar na Vila Formosa
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) faced two protests during his second campaign agenda in São Paulo, including demonstrations against Governor Tarcísio de Freitas. At both stops, he played football with children, scored two goals, and was greeted with whistles and repudiation signs. Other candidates like Guilherme Derrite and André do Prado were also present during the events.

item.title: TSE decide que Marçal não pode ter fundo eleitoral nem ir a debates
item.description: The TSE unanimously barred Pablo Marçal from accessing electoral and party funding, and blocked his participation in debates and radio and TV campaigns due to doubts about his party affiliation. The precautionary measure was issued following a request by the Electoral Public Ministry, which pointed out irregularities in his affiliation with PRTB and previous ties to União Brasil. The campaign canceled events scheduled for Thursday and awaits the TSE's ruling on the candidacy registration.

item.title: Simulador tira dúvida de eleitores sobre a votação; saiba mais
item.description: The TSE Voting Simulator allows voters to practice the voting process using fictional candidates and numbers, helping to prevent errors on election day.

item.title: ‘Precisamos que Justiça autorize Michelle ser substituída no cuidado de Bolsonaro’, diz Valdemar
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, leader of the PL party, requested judicial authorization to replace Michelle Bolsonaro in caring for Jair Bolsonaro, freeing her for her Senate campaign and support for Flávio Bolsonaro. He emphasized Michelle's charisma as an asset for Flávio's presidential campaign and attributed the senator's messaging shifts to new communication strategies.

item.title: Margem Equatorial Brasileira: desafios e potencial em soberania, desenvolvimento e transição justa
item.description: The discovery of hydrocarbons in the Amazon mouth sedimentary basin, in the Brazilian Equatorial Margin, reinforces the country's energy potential and Petrobras' expertise in ultra-deep waters. Despite the need for economic and environmental feasibility assessments, the finding contributes to national energy security and strategic sovereignty. Ineep and FUP emphasize the urgency of a long-term energy planning with social participation and state coordination.

item.title: Aneel diz não ter verba para divulgar mercado livre de energia
item.description: The Brazilian electricity regulator Aneel states it lacks budget resources to fund the communication campaign required by the presidential decree opening the free energy market to residential consumers. Director-general Sandoval Feitosa said the agency needs additional funding to hire advertising and communication agencies and has requested support from the Chief of Staff and the Ministry of Planning. Although facing financial constraints, Aneel says it is willing to implement the outreach plan if provided with the necessary resources.

item.title: Flávio joga futebol em SP, marca 2 gols e é carregado após partida
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro played soccer with children in São Paulo, scored two goals, and was celebrated by participants. During his agenda in the capital, he visited the Mercadão de São Miguel alongside Mayor Ricardo Nunes and Senate candidates, facing a protest.

item.title: Durigan diz que quer conversar com Malan e Arminio. Mas quer ouvi-los para quê?
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan stated he intends to speak with liberal economists like Pedro Malan and Arminio Fraga, but raises concerns over whether such meetings will be symbolic or translate into genuine policy dialogue. The analysis questions if these figures will be truly consulted or merely used as a credibility stamp amid growing fiscal and public debt challenges.

item.title: JOTA Principal | Crise no varejo aumenta pressão fiscal e preocupa governo e campanha de Lula
item.description: The retail crisis, worsened by Casas Bahia's judicial recovery, has increased fiscal pressure and concerns the government and Lula's campaign. High interest rates and lack of fiscal adjustment worry businesses, banks, and the president's allies, who see risks to the economy and re-election.

item.title: STF AO VIVO – Atuação do MPU e emendas parlamentares- sessão de 20/8/2026
item.description: The STF rules on ADI 5982 regarding the performance of the MPU in Santa Catarina and joint actions on parliamentary amendments in Mato Grosso, Paraíba, and Rondônia, including cases resumed after suspensions by ministers such as Edson Fachin and Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Ambiente digital seguro depende de toda a sociedade, indica debate com 'jovens senadores'
item.description: During a public hearing of the Commission on Education and Culture, participants of the Young Senator Program 2026 discussed the creation of safer digital environments and the fight against misinformation. Senator Paulo Paim emphasized the importance of dialogue between young people and experts to foster a healthy and democratic cyberspace, while TSE representatives stressed the need to adapt communication and regulation amid high political polarization.

item.title: Deputado do PL entra na UFBA para tirar adesivos do PT e gera tumulto
item.description: State Deputy Diego Castro (PL-BA) entered UFBA to remove stickers supporting Lula and Governor Jerônimo Rodrigues, causing a disturbance with students and professors at the Ondina campus in Salvador. The lawmaker was recorded removing campaign materials and claimed he was assaulted while preventing a supposed PT campaign.

item.title: Presidente da CCJ do Senado doa R$ 100 mil para filho candidato
item.description: The president of the Senate's Constitution and Justice Committee, Otto Alencar (PSD-BA), donated R$ 100,000 to his son Daniel Alencar's (PSD-BA) campaign for the Chamber of Deputies. The donation exceeds the senator's declared assets in 2022.

item.title: Mendonça manda derrubar vídeo com IA que liga Flávio a Vorcaro
item.description: TSE Minister André Mendonça ordered the removal of an AI-generated video linking candidate Flávio Bolsonaro to Banco Master CEO Daniel Vorcaro using deepfake imagery in a musical parody format. The Instagram post, made by an unidentified profile, must be removed within 24 hours under review for possible electoral violations.

item.title: Onde estão os campeões olímpicos 10 anos após medalha de ouro inédita
item.description: Ten years after Brazil's first-ever Olympic gold medal in 2016, the victorious squad members have taken varied paths: several play in Europe or Brazilian clubs, some have retired, and a few earned call-ups for the 2026 World Cup.

item.title: Não vejo que há excesso de isenções fiscais em São Paulo hoje, diz Tarcísio
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) stated there is no excessive tax exemptions in the state, rejecting criticism from his opponent Fernando Haddad (PT). The debate on tax exemptions is a recurring theme in Tarcísio's re-election campaign. He argues that current exemptions are within normal parameters and contribute to the state's economic development.

item.title: Tarcísio diz que não houve queda na qualidade da educação em SP e critica Haddad
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas claimed there was no decline in education quality in the state, countering rival Fernando Haddad's frequent criticisms. He defended his administration's record and challenged Haddad's assertions as baseless.

item.title: Pernambuco: Raquel Lyra exalta parceria com Lula, mas evita declarar voto para presidente
item.description: Raquel Lyra praises partnership with Lula but avoids declaring presidential vote. The governor of Pernambuco, running for re-election with the PSD, keeps her campaign focused on the state race and does not mention Ronaldo Caiado.
